mintAuthority.summary: nWISDOM has issuer-native local deposit/mint paths on Ethereum, Plume, BNB Chain, and Solana. Ethereum, Plume, and BNB use the current NestVaultPredicateProxy and chain-local NestVault paths; Solana uses a Nest SPL mint authority. These native issuance controls are separate from LayerZero OFT and CCTP transfer machinery, which is authored under Bridge Risk. No hard aggregate supply cap is evidenced, and the current authority graph therefore remains adverse despite the documented deposit/NAV accounting invariant.

controls.label: Nest nWISDOM Ethereum NestVault deposit path
controls.capDescription: The documented native path approves the PredicateProxy and deposits into the Ethereum USDC NestVault at vault NAV. No hard aggregate supply cap or complete bypass analysis is evidenced.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770023, the documented nWISDOM native flow used the chain-local NestVaultPredicateProxy 0xfc0c4222b3a0c9b060c0b959dec62442036b9035 and USDC NestVault 0x6330a14fc1520cfdf0834ccf23b15fd47a89a651. The share token and NestVault owner() reads returned 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a, while the PredicateProxy owner() returned the Nest 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982.

controls.label: Nest nWISDOM Plume NestVault deposit path
controls.capDescription: The documented native path approves the PredicateProxy and deposits into the Plume USDC or pUSD NestVault at vault NAV. No hard aggregate supply cap or complete bypass analysis is evidenced.
controls.evidence: At Plume block 87667298, the documented nWISDOM native flow used the chain-local NestVaultPredicateProxy 0xfc0c4222b3a0c9b060c0b959dec62442036b9035 and the USDC NestVault 0x6330a14fc1520cfdf0834ccf23b15fd47a89a651. The share token and NestVault owner() reads returned 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a, while the PredicateProxy owner() returned the Nest 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982.

controls.label: Nest nWISDOM BNB NestVault deposit path
controls.capDescription: The documented native path approves the PredicateProxy and deposits BNB USDT into the local nWISDOM NestVault at vault NAV. No hard aggregate supply cap or complete bypass analysis is evidenced.
controls.evidence: At BNB block 116342916, owner() on the nWISDOM share token and the documented USDT NestVault 0xf6d67d698c139c217cf645c285dfac183f3ca45b returned 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a. owner() on the common PredicateProxy returned the Nest 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982. The same block showed deployed code for all three contracts.

controls.label: Nest nWISDOM Ethereum share and NestVault owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770023, owner() on both the nWISDOM share token and the USDC NestVault returned the Nest admin contract 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a. This owner is an issuer-native administrative surface, not the LayerZero transfer rail.

controls.label: Nest nWISDOM Plume share and NestVault owner
controls.evidence: At Plume block 87667298, owner() on both the nWISDOM share token and the USDC NestVault returned the Nest admin contract 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a. This owner is an issuer-native administrative surface, not the LayerZero transfer rail.

controls.label: Nest nWISDOM BNB share and NestVault owner
controls.evidence: At BNB block 116342916, owner() on both the nWISDOM share token and the documented USDT NestVault 0xf6d67d698c139c217cf645c285dfac183f3ca45b returned the Nest admin contract 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a. This owner is an issuer-native administrative surface, not the LayerZero transfer rail.

controls.label: Nest 3-of-6 Safe (current PredicateProxy owner across EVM native routes)
controls.evidence: The Ethereum and Plume fixed-block reviews and the BNB block 116342916 read identify 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 as the current NestVaultPredicateProxy owner on the EVM native routes. The Safe observation at Ethereum block 25295096 confirmed a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe v1.3.0+L2 with no enabled modules and no guard; its current route role is native deposit authorization, while LayerZero peer and DVN administration remains under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: BNB NestVaultPredicateProxy ProxyAdmin
controls.capDescription: The EIP-1967 admin can replace the BNB PredicateProxy implementation and therefore alter the native deposit/mint path. The admin's owner() resolves to the same Nest 3-of-6 Safe.
controls.evidence: At BNB block 116342916, the EIP-1967 implementation slot of 0xfc0c4222b3a0c9b060c0b959dec62442036b9035 resolved to 0xc3cbd254c8b539e6ae7f7e0b93558778e75fb66e and its admin slot resolved to 0xeff5d7efccd4492a65a6bc539adc5bdb28d575f0. A current owner() read on that admin returned 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982.

controls.label: nWISDOM Solana SPL mint authority (1-of-2 multisig)
controls.capDescription: The nWISDOM SPL mint has no authored on-chain supply cap. Its 1-of-2 mint-authority multisig can mint directly; the documented CCTP-to-Plume and LayerZero OFT settlement path is separately scored under Bridge Risk.
controls.evidence: At Solana slot 439718375, getAccountInfo for the nWISDOM mint 77DTSzxisdQWshFYHP9M2JBDuHNojLAVoC7GBNC2yadT returned decimals 6, mintAuthority and freezeAuthority 9zXJ3JWM1HtUrjgkLstDnHyZjVLgpxeZGbET8cJoea9Y. At slot 439718400, that SPL Token multisig returned numRequiredSigners 1, numValidSigners 2, with signers RgP5qMfX58PBLm6EoEgCfgfWxLdVBmGTm6bYnD3kECq and J9tZ5VVz9qFiz8YQ1ktvkSonXPmVmn8dXefcKgowZw3J.

review.evidence: Current Nest documentation and fixed observations now cover issuer-native nWISDOM issuance on Ethereum, Plume, BNB Chain, and Solana. Ethereum block 25770023 and Plume block 87667298 identified the local share/NestVault owner 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a and the PredicateProxy owner 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982; BNB block 116342916 confirmed the same owner graph plus a mutable PredicateProxy implementation and admin; Solana slots 439718375-439718400 confirmed a 1-of-2 SPL mint authority with no authored supply cap. Native local deposit and mint controls are recorded here, while LayerZero OFT, CCTP, composer, peer, and DVN controls remain in Bridge Risk. The documented NAV/deposit accounting does not establish a hard aggregate cap or independent whole-supply reconciliation, so the adverse economic annotations remain scoreable and the profile confidence is manual-review pending the unresolved per-route control graph.
